purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
summary: Utsunomiya City publishes a citywide 地籍図/地番図 Shapefile dataset. A bounded anonymous inspection of the split covering the preserved WUP point returned six parcel polygons; three were retained with only BUKKEN_NO-derived canonical IDs. The city warning makes this a tax-assessment reference map, not a legal parcel-boundary source, so runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Japanese first-party discovery queries are recorded in the city record. They found the city publication and catalog, plus Ministry of Justice national map-data context. The city catalog states all-Utsunomiya scope, JGD2011 Japan Plane Rectangular CS IX, six split ZIP resources, and Creative Commons Attribution; the city warning limits the map to reference/tax-assessment use.
requestOutcomes: GET of the official catalog page returned HTTP 200. GET of the official field-definition PDF returned HTTP 200. GET of the official 01_01 Shapefile ZIP returned HTTP 200/application-zip. The archive was inspected locally with OGR: layer 筆界線01 is Polygon, EPSG:6677, and a bounded native-coordinate query around the exact preserved WUP point returned six features. The 02_02 through 06_06 official ZIP download URLs were discovered but not downloaded because one split was sufficient for a bounded sample and the citywide claim is recorded as claimed scope. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS-disable action was used.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Official city publication and catalog link found.
Official CKAN-like dataset page exposed scope, CRS, resources, field-definition PDF, and license.
Field-definition PDF downloaded and read; BUKKEN_NO and related native fields documented; CRS stated as JGD2011 Zone IX.
01_01 ZIP downloaded to ignored scratch; 筆界線01 polygon layer inspected and bounded query returned six features.
National MOJ page was blocked to this fetch; search result still identified it as national G-Space context, not local-service evidence.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [36.5514923896268, 139.885051050438] was preserved; no coordinate shift was made.
One split archive and one bounded area were inspected; no claim is made that the exact point is a parcel hit or that all city parcels are complete.
The city explicitly says the map does not prove legal boundaries, exact position/shape, or rights.
National MOJ documentation is not treated as the local Utsunomiya source.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or personal fields were requested or retained.
safeFieldAllowlist: source layer and public service metadata
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond safe native parcel ID
nativeIdentityPolicy: Retained GeoJSON contains exactly one canonical id property derived from BUKKEN_NO. Native field mapping and composite-key considerations remain in this review; no synthetic row number was used.
crs: EPSG:6677 / JGD2011 Japan Plane Rectangular CS IX; retained sample reprojected to GeoJSON EPSG:4326 with longitude/latitude coordinate order.
geometryQuality: Three complete Polygon features retained from the bounded response; no raw native attribute set retained.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: The source is a public citywide reference dataset and locally evidenced, but legal cadastral status, completeness across all split archives, and adapter suitability remain unresolved.
